notes.content:

More improvements and content updates are coming soon. Thank you for playing Square City Builder!

notes.content:
A new update for Square City Builder is now available, focusing on improving localization and fixing some reported issues.

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]

[list]

[h3]Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Let us know if you encounter any other issues.[/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.5.0
notes.content:
We’re here with a new update that includes a few tweaks to improve gameplay experience and fix an important issue. The biggest change in this update was the fix for a Steamworks bug that had stopped working in recent versions. This issue has now been resolved, and Steamworks is back to working as expected!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZJRCjJX.jpeg[/img]
[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Small gameplay tweaks to enhance experience.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused Steamworks to malfunction in recent versions. Everything is now working as expected!
[/list]

Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback. Enjoy the updates!

Feel free for leave your feedback about the game here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2561770/discussions/0/4038104133471962224/

tags.bug: [*] Fixed the bug that caused Steamworks to malfunction in recent versions. Everything is now working as expected!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 and japanese version available!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2561770/ss_e7473189fe2e5b2e03d3838e7c7b5b97f4377a0b.600x338.jpg?t=1702111285[/img]

[h3]Square City Builderは今、日本語に対応しています！この素晴らしい新機能に加えて、ゲームにはいくつかの変更が加えられました：[/h3]

[list]
[*] 汚染や環境災害などの新しいイベント；
[*] マップのバランス調整、環境生成の均衡；
[*] 道路の破壊時間（メンテナンス）のバランス；
[*] 木材産業から得られる利益のバランス。
[/list]

[h3]Square City Builder now has support for the Japanese language! In addition to this great new feature, several modifications have been made to the game:[/h3]

[list]
[*] New events such as pollution and environmental disasters;
[*] Map balancing, environment generation equilibrium;
[*] Balancing of road destruction time (maintenance);
[*] Balancing of profit gained from the wood industry.
[/list]
